posts.body:
Released on 08/08/2025 at itch.io
THE GAME CAN BE DOWNLOADED HERE!!!
Trailer here
In the country of Milago exists a place called New Cesada, a small but extremely quickly developing city that has been experiencing disappearances for the last 30 years.
You play as Faron, a young art student who got trapped inside the Igneferia, a mini-mall that will be closing and won't be seeing anyone else entering in a month.Meet locals such as Starr, an imp who knows the ins and outs of New Cesada and Zerca, an ex-journalist who has been investigating the disappearances on his own.
Mimico's gameplay is simple, being a linear and story focused game, you will only ever need to focus on solving simple puzzles to advance and having to shake off some bad apples you might encounter along the way. As you progress, you will be able to advance to other floors and meet your crew.
Saving is done via finding flickering TVs, where you have the option between saving and reading additional dialog between party members and even other characters that might be standing around nearby. You can read these pieces of dialog to learn more about the world, the characters, or simply where to go next.
Try to find your way out, learn about the secrets of this town and may fortune be on your side.
Game by Inconclusive Name
Music by Manlink
Controls:
Arrow Keys - Move
Z - Interact
X - Cancel/menu
F5 - Fullscreen
F12 - Reset
D - Cow​
